purpose: Teach: 実写/か国/捧げる/煽り/引っ張ら/鵜呑み/広める/築か

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、自然ドキュメンタリーの実写、調査資料に良いですね。
lines.en: Sakura, this nature documentary footage is really good material for your research.
lines.style: Warm observation. Slight upward inflection on the name. Thoughtful pause before the compliment. Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。二十か国の環境問題、紹介されていました。
lines.en: Yes. It covered environmental issues across twenty countries.
lines.style: Engaged but measured. Clean delivery on the number. A slight nod in the voice—showing she's absorbed the material. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 環境保護に人生を捧げる科学者、印象的ですね。
lines.en: The scientists who dedicate their lives to conservation—that's striking.
lines.style: Drawn in by the subject matter. Soft emphasis on 'dedicate.' Thoughtful, almost contemplative. The kind of comment that invites deeper thinking.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。一部メディアの煽り、誤解を生んでいます。
lines.en: Yes. But some media sensationalism creates misunderstanding around their actual work.
lines.style: Careful, discerning tone. A slight hardening on 'sensationalism'—she's thinking critically. Not accusatory, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 流行に引っ張られない研究姿勢、見習いたいですね。
lines.en: That research rigor—staying independent from trends—that's something to learn from.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Slow, measured pace. This is sincere reflection, not casual comment. Gentle emphasis on 'independent.'

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。研究を鵜呑みにせず、再現実験、大事ですね。
lines.en: Yes. We shouldn't just accept research at face value—reproducing experiments is crucial.
lines.style: Focused, direct. A little more energy than before—she's naming something important. Clear on 'reproducing.' Practical wisdom.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 環境意識を広める活動、若者の役割ですね。
lines.en: Getting young people involved in spreading environmental awareness—that's your generation's role.
lines.style: Purposeful, slightly forward-leaning energy. Calm conviction. This is an observation that carries weight—not pressure, just clarity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。新たな研究分野が築かれる時代、感じます。
lines.en: Yes. We're building new fields of research right now. You can feel it.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. Slight breathlessness—she believes this. The last phrase lands softly, almost intimate. A door opening.
